name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.15.5 preserves short branded product identities such as Nike Dunk, uses bounded Catalog descriptions as product evidence, and keeps added memory or storage requirements separate from stable product identity. Reviewed Awin merchants remain eligible for trusted exact-and-similar matches, while qualifying Shopify results are labeled as high-rated Shopify merchants. Commission never changes product relevance scoring. Railway serves 50 reviewed official storefronts and 150 trusted merchants from schema-valid immutable releases; invalid or unavailable database snapshots cannot replace the last valid registry. Official cards require an approved exact domain, verified product identity, a valid public USD price, and stable product identity; unsupported or blocked sites fail closed and may use user-authorized Chrome only as a fallback. Product family and explicit brand/model stay hard; uncertain visual details remain soft clues and never create EXACT identity. Text search treats a maximum budget as a ceiling and never recommends products absent from returned cards. Exact selected-product follow-ups reuse stable selection identity. Price-history and buy-or-wait forecasting remain disabled. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Call the matching tool. Reply only in request language. No Memory, repo, logs, task, cache, plan, or manual MCP launch.
